0e68de.title: Perform SAST and Static Triage Scan
0e68de.description: Run semgrep, AST-grep, gitleaks, and trivy fs across /workspace/routers to identify potential injection, auth bypass, secret leaks, and security weaknesses.

34fb05.title: Analyze Authentication & User Management Routers
34fb05.description: Analyze auth.py, users.py, password_requests.py, audit.py, system.py for authentication bypasses, JWT issues, privilege escalation, weak password handling, and broken function level authorization.

bc348c.title: Analyze Academic & Content Management Routers
bc348c.description: Analyze academic.py, content.py, marks.py, student_grades.py, subjects.py, teachers.py for IDOR, SQL/NoSQL injection, file upload bugs, and authorization flaws.

74a8d8.title: Analyze Operations & Financial Routers
74a8d8.description: Analyze attendance.py, fees.py, parent.py, batches.py, complaints.py, timetable.py, notifications.py for business logic flaws, IDOR, race conditions, and parameter tampering.
